title: Hold a plumbing licence
what: Carry out prescribed plumbing work only under a practitioner's licence of the relevant class, or as a supervised trainee.

sources.title: Occupational Licensing Act 2005 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out any prescribed work, other than building services work, unless – (a) the person holds a practitioner's licence of the relevant occupation and class;

sources.title: Occupational Licensing (Plumbing Work) Regulations 2021 (Tas)
sources.quote: the following work is determined to be prescribed work, unless exempted under section 99(1)(b) of the Act: (a) work carried out on, or as part of, the design, construction, installation, replacement, repair, alteration, maintenance, servicing, testing, commissioning, decommissioning or removal of any part of the following plumbing installations or systems: (i) sanitary;
